title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: ‘Welcomes the update of the EU Visa Code Handbook in relation to HRDs and calls for its full and consistent application by the Member States; reiterates its call for the Commission to take a proactive role in the establishment of a coordinated approach among the Member States for HRDs at risk,’
